annotations.title: Live fast chargers on a road trip

description: Fast chargers (DC or 50 kW and more) within 2 km of one Roadcut road trip, with how many are free, in use or out of order now, power, card payment and, where published, the price without an app: in euros, or in the local currency in its own field for Poland (PLN) and Denmark (DKK); for Norway and Sweden the networks' published list price in NOK or SEK, not a live price. Refreshed about every 20 minutes from open operator data. Live status exists for Germany, the Netherlands, France, Finland, Poland, Slovenia, Luxembourg, Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Belgium. A trip is identified by its slug.

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

only_free.description: Only stations with at least one free charger. Default false.
